anchor_basis: Median centerline ground of the 2 / 4 / 6 m outside nonbridge approach probes. End/node and valley ground values are not assumed to be deck elevations. Vertical line across the bridge is original architectural inference, not a deck DSM. Variable source accuracy retained.
estimated_dimensions: Arch rise, crown/parapet dimensions and transition distance are bounded original reconstruction from the 2024 photograph taken at the site and approach heights. No measured engineering elevation/section of the bridge recovered.
ground_policy: Existing field represents valley ground, with~6.6 m low point between~22.5 m road approaches. Preserve it below the arch. No prism, hillside flattening, terraincutout or native driving/contact change. Exact original ground planes required only at bounded approach ties; no geometry outside mapped bridge/qualified nonbridge support strips changes.
source_licences: Literal OSM outline/centerline, ODbL 1.0. Literal IGN approach/valley observations, Open Licence 2.0.2024 photo review-only, no texture copying.
source_epoch_note: OSM retained snapshot and 2024 primary arch photograph; 2019 orthophoto. Supplied edited reference year unverified.
status: Qualified bridge plan and declared architectural estimates; native cooked review remains required.
